title: "Pullquote Test: Font Sizes"

## Symmetrical Size Scale

This tests the new balanced API size scale (4 steps down, 4 steps up from normal).

```markdown
::: {.pullquote size="pq-size-3xs"}
This is extra extra extra small.
:::
```

::: {.pullquote size="pq-size-3xs"}
This is extra extra extra small.
:::

```markdown
::: {.pullquote size="pq-size-2xs"}
This is extra extra small.
:::
```

::: {.pullquote size="pq-size-2xs"}
This is extra extra small.
:::

```markdown
::: {.pullquote size="pq-size-xs"}
This is extra small.
:::
```

::: {.pullquote size="pq-size-xs"}
This is extra small.
:::

```markdown
::: {.pullquote size="pq-size-s"}
This is small.
:::
```

::: {.pullquote size="pq-size-s"}
This is small.
:::

```markdown

This is normal size.

```

::: {.pullquote size="pq-size-normal"}
This is normal size.
:::
